title: [Bug][202405]: Failed: Orch CPU utilization  > orch cpu threshold 10 before link flap
author: arista-hpandya
body:
### Issue Description

The `platform_tests/link_flap/test_cont_link_flap.py` test checks whether the CPU% utilization is less than 10% before it begins flapping the interfaces. However, this check fails intermittently on a modular chassis in T2 topology.

### Results you see

```
E       Failed: Orch CPU utilization  > orch cpu threshold 10 before link flap
--------------------------------------------------
	 platform_tests 1
--------------------------------------------------
	 2024-12-15 23:36:09: platform_tests/link_flap/test_cont_link_flap.py::TestContLinkFlap::test_cont_link_flap[cmp227-5]
```

### Results you expected to see

We expect it to pass.

### Is it platform specific

generic

linkedPullRequests.title: Increase Orch CPU utilization timeout before link flap
linkedPullRequests.author: arista-hpandya
linkedPullRequests.body:
This change was made because in modular chassis with multi-asic LCs, the link flap test might run on the uplink LC followed by the downlink LC. Since the uplink has a lot of neighbors the downlink CPU is busy re-routing the different pathways. In such a scenario, the downlink LC will still be hot (above 10% utilization) before we flap its interfaces. Hence, the increase in timeout.

We tested it with a timeout of 500 and it failed so we are increasing it to 600 which has been passing on our local T2 testbeds.
